Game Overview

My Army Base puts players into a tycoon experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Each session of My Army Base follows a consistent rhythm. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is My Army Base?

My Army Base is a free tycoon game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is My Army Base free to play?

Yes, My Army Base is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
